sarah: Heads-up team — scheduling an external assessment. Proposed window: Tue 2024-07-02 10:00-14:00 PT. Need an access runway: RBAC snapshot, ephemeral assessor roles, KMS access pattern, audit export, and evidence packaging. Who can take ownership?
liam: I can own RBAC & ephemeral roles. Plan: create timeboxed roles `assessor-external-*` with max session 3h, require MFA and tag `assessment=external`. Will produce pre/post RBAC diffs.
olivia: I'll own KMS + logs. Pattern: assessors get DescribeKey + Encrypt only. Decrypts via a locked decrypt-handler in our control plane (recorded ops only). Mirror CloudTrail -> s3://assessment-runway-5067809999/ and produce a hashed export.
sec-bot: [automated] Created SEC-33333: "External assessment - access runway" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-33333
oncall-sre: I'll schedule the infra canary at 09:00 PT day-of and handle the bucket provisioning. We'll disable object-lock so assessors can upload packaging artifacts; bucket uses SSE-KMS (alias/assessment-runway). Presigned PUTs expire 6h.
sarah: Minimal gating checklist before assessors start: 1) pre-RBAC snapshot (commit SHA + diff), 2) cloudtrail-hash.txt in bucket, 3) KMS key policy snapshot, 4) evidence manifest with sha256s and sanitization flags.
liam: RBAC snapshot plan: run `aws iam get-account-authorization-details` and normalize to CSV principal, resource, actions. Commit to private repo, sign commit, include commit SHA in manifest. Will post script to SEC-33333.
olivia: Decrypt-handler will only return an audit-blob and HMAC of plaintext. If plaintext is required, sec-ops runs a recorded session and places the result in a one-time presigned, SSE-KMS protected object. We'll rate-limit decrypt requests and alert >3/hr.
sarah: Evidence rules: no raw PII. Assessors receive a redacted artifact + a sanitized manifest. If they request sensitive samples, that goes through the decrypt-request flow and sec-ops approval.
liam: Example session policy for assessor (session-level):
```json
{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["s3:PutObject","s3:ListBucket"], "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::assessment-runway-5067809999/*" }, { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:DescribeKey"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*" } ] }
```
liam: I'll also add a session policy restricting S3 to `metadata/*` and `manifest.csv` for read. Actual findings uploads go to `findings/` prefix.
olivia: KMS key policy will include a deny for `kms:Decrypt` unless `aws:RequestTag/assessment`= `external` and caller is decrypt-handler role. Will attach snippet to SEC-33333.
oncall-sre: Canary steps: snapshot SGs and IAM, apply assessor-only SGs, deploy decrypt-handler in locked subnet, run end-to-end synthetic upload, mirror CloudTrail -> s3://assessment-runway-5067809999/cloudtrail/, compute `sha256sum` over exports and upload `cloudtrail-hash-5067809999.sha256`. Rollback script revokes assessor roles + isolates subnet.
sarah: Retest gating proposal: A) No open Criticals. B) All Highs fixed OR have documented compensating control + scheduled fix. C) Evidence manifest & RBAC diffs present. D) CloudTrail hash present. If any missing -> 48h hold and RCA.
liam: For evidence packaging we'll require manifest.csv with columns: filename,path,sha256,sanitized_flag,submitter,commit_sha. Sample upload command for assessors:
```bash
aws s3 cp findings.json s3://assessment-runway-5067809999/findings/findings.json --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/assessment-runway
sha256sum findings.json > findings.json.sha256
aws s3 cp findings.json.sha256 s3://assessment-runway-5067809999/metadata/
```
olivia: Operational guard: decrypt-handler must emit logs with `request_id, caller, timestamp, hmac(plaintext)` and store them encrypted in the evidence bucket. Alert if handler invoked >3 times/hour.
sarah: Owners: liam -> RBAC snapshots + roles + terraform diff, olivia -> KMS proxy + logs + runbook, oncall-sre -> infra window + canary + rollback, sarah -> assessor coordination + evidence acceptance. I'll update SEC-33333 with assignees.
sec-bot: [automated] SEC-33333 updated: assignees set to liam, olivia, sarah, oncall-sre; due date 2024-06-30
liam: I'll post the RBAC script and the pre-window commit SHA 24h before.
olivia: I'll open PR for decrypt-handler and include unit tests preventing plaintext logging.
oncall-sre: We'll run a tabletop for the killswitch next week to rehearse revoke + isolate flow.
sarah: Thanks all — reconvene in #eng-security 24h before the window for final go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
